newsitem.title: USA: Centennial sees no reason for stock drop.
newsitem.headline: Centennial sees no reason for stock drop.

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc said on Tuesday it saw no reason for the recent fall in its stock price.
At midday, shares of the maker of personal computer card-based solutions were down 2-1/8 to 33-7/8. Volume was heavy at 719,000 shares traded.
"We have no explanation as to why the stock is going down," Centennial spokeswoman Linda Decker told Reuters.
She added, "Business is fine and the stock should not be down. I wish it would turn around, because I'm inundated with calls."
Shares in the Billerica, Mass., company have fallen from 58-1/2 on Dec 30.
Centennial said last week it got orders of about $44 million in the second quarter, which ended Dec 31. That figure was up from $14 million a year earlier.
